resources.string: Your name must have at least 3 characters!
Cats use their whiskers to detect nearby objects and judge narrow spaces.
Cat tongues have tiny structures that help remove loose fur while grooming.
Cats see better than humans in low-light environments.
Scratching surfaces helps cats remove old layers from their claws.
Dogs do not see only in black and white: they can distinguish shades of blue and yellow.
Dogs have sweat glands in their paw pads.
Panting helps dogs release heat and regulate their body temperature.
Dogs can hear higher-pitched sounds than humans.
Puppies have 28 baby teeth, while adult dogs usually have 42 teeth.
Bird bones are hollow and lightweight to help with flight.
Hummingbirds are the only birds that can fly backwards.
Birds have no teeth and use their gizzards to grind food.
Owls can rotate their heads up to 270 degrees.
Pigeons have a natural internal compass based on the magnetic field for navigation.
